info.title: HELIORA
info.description: AI-Powered Preventive Health Intelligence Platform API. HELIORA is not a medical diagnosis tool.

post.description: [DEPRECATED per ADR-011: Use Supabase Auth for user registration.] Registers a new user account with validated credentials and returns a legacy JWT access token.
[DEPRECATED per ADR-011: Use Supabase Auth for user authentication.] Authenticates user credentials provided via JSON body and returns a legacy JWT bearer token.
[DEPRECATED per ADR-011: Kept for OpenAPI Swagger UI and legacy local dev.] OAuth2-compatible form login endpoint for Swagger UI authorization.

get.description: Returns the profile data of the currently authenticated user.

post.description: Records user affirmative agreement to privacy terms, data processing, and medical disclaimer.

get.description: Retrieves active consent state for authenticated user along with current medical disclaimer text.

post.description: Revokes active consent record for authenticated user in compliance with privacy regulations (UU PDP / GDPR).

get.description: Retrieves the current active health profile of authenticated user.

put.description: Updates specified biometric or lifestyle fields of the authenticated user's health profile, recalculating BMI and enforcing active consent.

post.summary: Create or save user health profile
post.description: Saves biometric, lifestyle, and clinical parameters for the authenticated user. Computes BMI and enforces consent requirement.

post.summary: Trigger and run new health assessment
post.description: Executes the Preventive Lifestyle Risk Engine against the user's active health profile. Calculates multi-condition risks, scores, factors, and stores outcomes. Requires active consent agreement before processing.

get.description: Returns the most recent risk assessment outcome for the authenticated user. Returns 404 if the user has not completed any assessments.
Retrieves a specific assessment session by UUID for the authenticated user.

post.description: Projects estimated health scores and multi-condition chronic disease risk trajectories over specified horizons (30, 90, 180 days) based on current habits. Operates in-memory without mutating persistent profile data (BR-SIM-007).

Recalculates multi-condition risks and health scores in real-time based on interactive lifestyle overrides (sleep, activity, weight, smoking). Zero permanent mutation to persistent user profile (BR-SIM-007).

get.description: Retrieves verified clinical evidence citations and international/national guidelines (WHO, PERKENI, CDC, ESC, AHA) with optional category, rule_id, and search keyword filtering (PRD FR-027, BR-EVIDENCE-001).
